big_messages: Q1 FY27: $159.5M (+1.1% CC), PAT 12.2% (-220 bps on mega-deal transition), book $149.2M seasonally soft
FY27 guide: mid-teens EBITDA; Q2-Q3 margins Q1-like on ramp-up; recovery from Q3; book-to-bill 0.9-1.1x
red_flags: Tier-1 competition everywhere — incumbents contesting deals they once ignored
TMT under pressure (-9.1%) + large-TMT-client drag; healthcare -3.8%, manufacturing -2.3%
H1 margin pressure: pre-staffing + transition + travel/visa; gross margin -300 bps Q1
Modest growth: 3.1% FY26, 1.1% Q1 CC; $149.2M book multi-quarter low; no mega deals in pipe
Stock -40% 1yr to Rs 433 — derated to 12.7x; limits downside but needs growth to re-rate
trends: Mega-deal era: $210M largest win, revenue ramps H2 FY27 after Feb transition start
AI-native at scale: 85% workforce certified, AI in every large deal, AgentMesh launch
BFSI engine: 48.8% of revenue, +8.3% QoQ CC — offsets TMT/healthcare softness
Cash fortress: $317.5M, DSO 75 days, op cash / EBITDA >70%, Rs 15 dividend (3.46%)
Pipeline shape: 23% large deals (>$25M), no mega; book-to-bill 0.9-1.1x; M&A up to $200M+

valuation.methodology: AlphaSpread primary live 26 Sep 2026 — DCF Rs 538.04 (firm model, 5yr: PV Rs 87.9B + cash Rs 9.3B + investments Rs 25.2B - debt Rs 0.44B = Rs 122B / 226.7m shares, Jul-12-2026 update) + Multiples-Based Rs 697.75 -> equal-weight blended Rs 617.90 ~= Intrinsic Rs 617.89, Buy Rs 494.32. Local cross-check: trailing 12.7x, EV/EBITDA ~7x on TTM EBITDA, P/B 2.09x, PAT margin 13.5%.
